```python
def test_fib4():
    # Base cases
    assert fib4(0) == 0
    assert fib4(1) == 0
    assert fib4(2) == 2
    assert fib4(3) == 0

    # Computed values
    assert fib4(4) == 2
    assert fib4(5) == 4
    assert fib4(6) == 8
    assert fib4(7) == 14
    assert fib4(8) == 28
    assert fib4(9) == 54
    assert fib4(10) == 104

    # Larger value to exercise the loop
    assert fib4(15) == 1942

    # Consistency: recurrence holds for n >= 4
    for n in range(4, 20):
        assert fib4(n) == fib4(n - 1) + fib4(n - 2) + fib4(n - 3) + fib4(n - 4)

    print("All tests passed!")


test_fib4()
```
